'''Kaimbulawa''' is an [[Austronesian language]] spoken on the island of [[Siompu]], southwest of [[Buton Island]], which is off the southeast coast of [[Sulawesi]] in [[Indonesia]]. It belongs to the [[Muna–Buton languages|Muna–Buton]] branch of the [[Celebic languages|Celebic]] subgroup.
